entities.name: Eusebia of Hamage
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eusebia, was a Frankish abbess of Hamage and is venerated as a saint whose feast day is 16 March. Versions of her name include Eusoye or Ysoie, which was the name of a village in the diocese of Beauvais, France.
